summary: No new declaration duplicates existing Mathlib or TauCeti material: Mathlib lacks a quadratic-form orthogonal group, reflection, and any bundled Pin/Lipschitz action, and the PR reuses the available combinators (ιInv, reflection, orthogonalGroup, Lipschitz range lemmas, toHomUnits, generalLinearEquiv) correctly.
